picks.name: Pumpkin Patch @ Frog Pond Farm
picks.description: Kick off pumpkin season at Frog Pond Farm — llamas, a bounce house, a corn box, and rows of gourds to pick. A wholesome, kid-friendly way to start October.

picks.name: Immigrant Worker Justice Benefit
picks.description: A benefit concert for immigrant worker justice at the Hawthorne Theatre, headlined by Portland's own Latin skacore crew Los Mal Hablados. A high-energy, big-hearted way to open Latiné Heritage Month.

picks.name: Lookout Landscape
picks.description: The World Forestry Center's immersive forest-art exhibition surrounds you in light, sound, and canopy. A quiet, dreamy escape into the woods without leaving the city.

picks.name: Hermanos Gutiérrez
picks.description: The Swiss-Ecuadorian brothers make cinematic, wordless desert guitar that fills a room — with Portland's own Y La Bamba opening. A gorgeous Latiné Heritage Month night at the Schnitzer.

picks.name: $6 Free Play @ Ground Kontrol
picks.description: Ground Kontrol flips to free play — one cover, all the pinball and classic arcade games you can handle. A nostalgic downtown afternoon (all-ages early, 21+ later).

picks.name: Dancing with the Rose City Stars
picks.description: Portland's spin on "Dancing with the Stars" pairs local personalities with pro dancers for a glittery night of competition at the Alberta Rose — all for a good cause.

picks.name: Free First Thursday · PAM
picks.description: The Portland Art Museum throws open its doors free all day for First Thursday. Wander world-class galleries downtown, then catch the Pearl District art walk after dark.

picks.name: This Is Not a Talk About AI
picks.description: A provocative live talk at Kiln that uses fire, anthropology, and technology to ask what makes us human. Come for big ideas and real conversation — not a tech pitch.

picks.name: Portland Greek Festival
picks.description: Three days of Greek food, pastries, dancing, and culture at Holy Trinity Cathedral — free to enter, impossible to leave hungry. Opa!

picks.name: Prost Oktoberfest
picks.description: Portland's favorite German bar throws a full Oktoberfest on N Mississippi — steins, brats, live oompah, and a heated tent. Peak fall in the city.

picks.name: Urban Harvest Cider Fest
picks.description: Leaven Community's free harvest fest presses fresh cider from neighborhood apples, with live music, crafts, and fall fun. Bring your own apples or other fruit to press, or just show up and enjoy!

picks.name: Tell All Your Friends
picks.description: Vol. 2 of the all-out pop-punk cover night at Dante's — sing along to every 2000s emo anthem you pretend you've outgrown. Eyeliner encouraged.

picks.name: Portland Craft Chocolate Festival
picks.description: Taste your way through dozens of craft chocolate makers at Olympic Mills — bean-to-bar samples, truffles, and more. A rich, delicious weekend for your sweet tooth.

picks.name: AVATARAVE
picks.description: A high-energy, anime-inspired queer rave at Holocene to close out the week — DJs, techno and house, and a come-as-your-favorite-character crowd. 21+.
